reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant exploit, outage, delisting, governance action, or near-term CAP supply event was substantiated. Monitoring freshness is mixed; CAP identity is likely Cap (cap.app), but the venue was not supplied.

facts.fact: CAP is the governance/utility token of Cap’s on-chain credit platform; official and exchange sources identify the asset as Cap (cap.app). ([okx.com](https://www.okx.com/en-us/help/okx-to-list-perpetual-futures-for-cap-crypto?utm_source=openai))

A third-party unlock tracker lists the next CAP unlock for June 25, 2027, not within the immediate trade horizon; this was not independently confirmed from project tokenomics. ([tokentoria.com](https://tokentoria.com/en/unlocks/cap-4/?utm_source=openai))

The latest official project material found was a September 15, 2026 product-transfer post; no official incident or maintenance notice was located in the reviewed results. ([cap.app](https://www.cap.app/blog/how-to-transfer-funds-from-fomo-to-cap?utm_source=openai))
